steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Blocking the way to the control tower... What the hell kind of Reunion operative you are?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Are you joining us, or are you trying to run away?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: If you want to fight us, that's your perogative! But this is as disgraceful as it is pointless!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Hold up... have you met this squad before?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: No. There's been a lot of new blood in Reunion ever since we left the tundras. I haven't ever bothered to get to know any of them.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: I'm getting the kind of feeling they're not...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Guard! Watch out!

steps.name: Reunion Member
steps.text: (Signal)

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Ursus troops!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Ugh...!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Fall back!! It's the Ursus!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Not going to say a peep till the very end, huh?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: What, you think I'm some kind of traitor?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: You think we're despicable for turning our backs on Ursus for some lowly Infected?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: We're fighting for their worthless lives, we're behind the times, and we've got no honor, so we should get our names taken off the registers and erased from history?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Maybe you have a husband or a wife, maybe you don't want to be here, but you still got sent by the higher-ups. You're just some puppetmaster's pawn, throwing away your life to do someone else's bidding...

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Pathetic! Pathetic, I tell you!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Have you killed any Ursus men before? Was it the Infected or regular citizens that you killed? When you got that blood on your hands, were you even afraid? Does that keep you up at night at all?

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: All of you who stayed even after the Emperor died... Pathetic!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Knock it off already! Fall back!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Careful! The Ursus troops are wearing Reunion's—

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: No, Guard!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: You mustn't say that...!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: The combatants on both sides will start doubting everyone around them if you say that... The more chaotic the situation is, the more of an advantage they'll have!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: If everything goes as Elysium planned, then the first thing we need to do...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...is to stop everyone right here.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: We don't have much time left, and we have no idea when Reunion will come barging their way to the control tower... It'll only get harder to organize an attack once that happens!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Not all of us need to fight this battle. We're up against Talulah. A small, disorganized squad isn't going to do us any good.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'll go.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Fall back! Fall back! Watch out for the piledriver spears! Find cover!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: Amiya... Not again... You're Rhodes Island's leader!

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I'm not going to tell you, 'That's all the more reason I should head in there.' ...All I'll say is, if there's something I can do and something needs to be done, then I'll do it, and I'll see it through.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Guard?
steps.text: And who's supposed to cover you?

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: Shieldguards, and that includes anyone who's injured. Let's do this. We'll hold the line here.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Feline...!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: They're rounding up all the special Infected and driving them out. So ruthless. They aren't showing even the tiniest bit of mercy...

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: I'll crush their position and ambush point.

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: ...Well then!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Feline, you're the first outsider ever to be backed up by both the Ursus Shieldguards and the guerilla fighters!
The young caster lifts her hand up. She pays no heed to the commotions of the battlefield, as though it matters not the slightest to her. Her eyes gleam with resolve.
Up until now, fear and regret have kept her chasing her endless flow of memories.
But now, her promise with her friend as well as the responsibility she shares with this embattlement of steel has given her cause to finally stop and rise up.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: No, I'm not an outsider.

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: We're a team now. We'll stop this city together!

steps.name: Rosmontis
steps.text: That's why I'm not an outsider!

steps.name: Shieldguard
steps.text: Shieldguards! Shields up!
